title: Group Fitness Class Passes: expiration window and credit-extension fee by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the number of days from purchase until unused credits expire, and the fee and number of extra days offered to extend expiring credits.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes the number of days, counted from the date the pack was purchased, after which unused credits expire. Each tier separately fixes a fee to extend expiring credits and the number of additional days such an extension adds to the tier's expiration window; a tier with a zero extension fee and zero extension days offers no such extension.

| Tier | Expiration window (days from purchase) | Credit-extension fee (USD) | Extension length (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 60 | 10.00 | 30 |
| 10-Class Pack | 90 | 10.00 | 30 |
| 20-Class Pack | 120 | 15.00 | 30 |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 30 | 0 | 0 |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 90 | 20.00 | 30 |
| Founding Class Pass | 120 | 5.00 | 30 |

## Points of judgement
- The Unlimited Monthly Classes tier is the only tier offering no credit-extension option at all (both its extension fee and extension length are zero); every other tier offers a 30-day extension at a tier-specific fee.
- Among the tiers that do offer an extension, the fee ranges from 5.00 (Founding Class Pass) to 20.00 (Specialty Studio Pack), while the extension length is uniformly 30 days.
